narratives.Overview: Post-merge hardening for issue #3609 after PR #3786 was externally merged before the final independent adversarial findings could be applied. The original setup-policy fix is delivered at merge commit e2b6221721ca60ccb5241d4ddb75a000bff52a11. This follow-up does not claim those later findings are delivered: it binds the remaining shared PROJECT-DEFINITION locking, configured-path, conformance-diagnostic, and machine-semantics fixes to one focused PR.
narratives.Description:
Flynn explicitly authorized this follow-up after the external merge of PR #3786. Scott's separate commit 6bf4e67cb628558cc6aa4bb388825e67b98d391f records lifecycle intent only and contains no production fixes; its valid acceptance intent is represented by the completed original #3609 xBRIEF, while this scope records the undelivered hardening.

Binding findings:
1. P1 stale-reap ABA: use a replacement-safe compare-and-remove protocol so two reapers cannot delete a newly acquired lock; cover the two-reaper race and keep the protocol POSIX/Windows safe.
2. P1 legacy/malformed sidecars: recover real legacy NUL, empty, partial, and malformed owner metadata without stealing a live lock; clean a failed or short owner-metadata creation's own inode.
3. P2 path binding: resolve the configured artifact target once and bind the same identity through lock, read, and atomic write; narrow fallback to the intended missing-layout condition; cover a configured symlink retarget race.
4. P2 conformance hostile keys: keep the semantic finding separate from a bounded, redacted, control-safe presentation for valid-JSON hostile keys.
5. P3 ShadowedPlanExtension semantics: preserve the true raw semantic key inventory in the exported field and provide a separate bounded/redacted display summary.

Out of scope: broader policy-registry cleanup, a second setup writer, weakening conformance, or changes unrelated to PROJECT-DEFINITION mutation/path identity and the two diagnostic surfaces.

items.title: The mutation lock uses replacement-safe stale-owner recovery and handles legacy, empty, partial, malformed, short-write, and two-reaper cases without stealing a live lock.
Configured PROJECT-DEFINITION paths resolve once so lock, read, and write share one artifact identity across symlink retargeting.
Configured-path conformance fails closed for missing, unreadable, malformed, and hostile-key artifacts with bounded redacted diagnostics.
ShadowedPlanExtension retains raw semantic key inventory and exposes a separate bounded redacted display summary.
The original #3609 xBRIEF is completed with verified acceptance evidence for merged PR #3786, without claiming this follow-up as delivered.

intended_placement.module_boundary: Shared PROJECT-DEFINITION path identity, mutation locking, policy shadow diagnostics, configured-path conformance diagnostics, their focused regressions, the follow-up lifecycle record, and one Unreleased note only.
intended_placement.cohesion_exemption: The configured-path and diagnostic files are required by the five binding post-merge findings and preserve one artifact identity from policy mutation through conformance. Upstream's canonical completed lifecycle record attests only PR #3786; the new active record governs this follow-up.

The I/O mock suite covers "legacy NUL" and malformed or partial owner metadata.
